strings.string: Use the watch thermometer to notice when you go in and out. LAP always works too.
How much the watch must warm in a minute to count as entering the sauna. Lower is more eager.
How much the watch must cool in a minute to count as leaving.
The watch buzzes when a round reaches this. 0 turns it off.
The watch buzzes when a break reaches this. 0 turns it off.
Shown as "round 2 of 3" on the live screen.
The band turns red and the watch buzzes every minute while its thermometer reads this or more. Garmin rates the watch to 45 °C.
